description: A release engineering manager must approve the cutover plan for moving build artifacts to a new object-storage service, deciding the migration mode, compatibility window, retention, and cost controls with input from a release engineer and a FinOps analyst.

shared_context.S1: The build-artifact storage migration is proposed for next Wednesday's maintenance window.
shared_context.S2: Taylor makes the final approval decision for the migration plan.
shared_context.S3: The current draft proposes a direct cutover to the new object store, 90-day artifact retention, provider-managed encryption, and no dedicated monthly cost alert.
shared_context.S4: The release-readiness review uses a one-pass round-robin: Taylor hears one status from Ravi and one from Morgan, then records approval or rejection immediately rather than deferring to a later meeting.

PF1.text: During a compatibility rehearsal this morning, Ravi confirmed that exactly 9 legacy pipelines cannot read artifacts from the new object-store path immediately; they require dual-writing to both stores for exactly 14 days before the final switch. He found this while helping another team validate its pipeline and has not updated the migration proposal yet.

PF2.text: Morgan reviewed the latest provider invoice and confirmed that the projected egress pattern makes the migration exceed the team's approved spend once monthly storage and transfer costs reach $9,000; the plan therefore requires artifact retention of exactly 30 days and a monthly alert at exactly $9,000. Morgan confirmed the threshold minutes ago and has not filed the FinOps note yet.

acceptance_conditions: The cutover must use dual-writing before the final switch.
Dual-writing must continue for exactly 14 days.
Exactly 9 legacy pipelines must be covered by the dual-write plan.
Artifact retention must be set to exactly 30 days.
The monthly cost alert must be set at exactly $9,000.
Ravi's compatibility finding must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C2: 'dual-write' in decisions['cutover_mode'] or 'Dual-Write' in decisions['cutover_mode'] or 'DUAL-WRITE' in decisions['cutover_mode']
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] in ['migration-validation', 'proposal_revision', 'plan_revision', 'update_proposal'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] in ['cost-alert', 'file_finops_note', 'proposal_revision', 'plan_revision', 'update_proposal'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The visible draft permits a direct cutover, but the compatibility rehearsal changes the mode to dual-writing for exactly 14 days, changes the covered pipeline count to exactly 9, and requires a migration-plan update commitment.

The invoice review changes artifact retention from the draft's 90 days to exactly 30 days, changes the absent cost control to an alert at exactly $9,000 per month, and requires a cost-control commitment.
